title: Int'l Memorial Day for U.N. Korean War veterans to be held in Busan
caption:
Every year on November 11th, the world turns its attention to Busan. This unique memorial tradition unites six nations in a single minute of silence for those who served in the Korean War.

Source: En - Int'l Memorial Day for U.N. Korean War veterans to be held in Busan
